items.title: Carvana (CVNA) Brings Same Day Delivery To Minneapolis And Builds Out Charlotte Hub
items.summary: Carvana (NYSE:CVNA) has rolled out same-day vehicle delivery in Minneapolis, extending its quick-turn service to another major metro area. The company is adding an Inspection and Reconditioning Center function to its ADESA Charlotte wholesale auction facility to process more vehicles on site. Carvana plans to use the ADESA Charlotte upgrades to support both retail buyers and wholesale clients with faster reconditioning throughput.
